guard: On an auth mesh the manager arms a turn's deadline hold over its serve connection (the timer row is the serving instance's), a spawned seat pulls and yields its turns under the baseline credential the manager minted for it, and an unyielded turn is denied at its deadline by the manager expiring the hold it owns.
why: Every other turn suite runs on an open mesh, where the broker enforces nothing. Two grant holes
shipped green that way: the hold minted over the goal-writer (no timer row, schedule denied,
every accept unwound) and the seat's pull under a baseline that carried self stop alone (the
and the run driver's own instrument carrying no turn request row (nothing minted one; the submit was dropped)
publish broker-dropped, the connector reading silence as no manager). This suite asks the
broker. The two grant mutants edit core, so the command builds core first and afterRestore
rebuilds it (dist/ is gitignored; the restore alone leaves the mutant compiled).

mutations.name: the hold is minted over the goal-writer connection again
mutations.expectRed: the run instrument's turn is ACCEPTED (the request row is granted; the hold's schedule published)
mutations.cell: the run instrument's turn is ACCEPTED (the request row is granted; the hold's schedule published)
mutations.note: The goal-writer profile holds no `ept` row; the `.schedule` publish is broker-denied and the accept unwinds with a failed terminal.

mutations.name: the operator seat-write set carries input alone; no profile mints a turn row
mutations.find: export const OPERATOR_SEAT_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(["input", "turn"] as const);
mutations.replace: export const OPERATOR_SEAT_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(["input"] as const);
mutations.expectRed: the run instrument's turn is ACCEPTED (the request row is granted; the hold's schedule published)
mutations.cell: the run instrument's turn is ACCEPTED (the request row is granted; the hold's schedule published)
mutations.note: Before this row existed nothing minted a turn request row; the run driver's control-caller-admin publish was broker-dropped and the caller saw deadline-exceeded.

mutations.name: the seat baseline carries self stop alone
mutations.find: export const BASELINE_SELF_LIFECYCLE_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(["stop", "turn-pending", "turn-yield"] as const);
mutations.replace: export const BASELINE_SELF_LIFECYCLE_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(["stop"] as const);
mutations.expectRed: the seat's minted credential is SERVED its pending turn, never broker-dropped
mutations.cell: the seat's minted credential is SERVED its pending turn, never broker-dropped
mutations.note: Without the self-mode turn-pending row the seat's publish is broker-dropped; the caller sees no responder.

mutations.name: the seat baseline pulls but cannot yield
mutations.find: export const BASELINE_SELF_LIFECYCLE_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(["stop", "turn-pending", "turn-yield"] as const);
mutations.replace: export const BASELINE_SELF_LIFECYCLE_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(["stop", "turn-pending"] as const);
mutations.expectRed: the seat's yield is served and completes the goal with its live currency
mutations.cell: the seat's yield is served and completes the goal with its live currency
mutations.note: The pull row alone shows a seat its turn and leaves it unable to answer; the yield publish is broker-dropped.

mutations.name: the sweep never expires the hold it owns
mutations.find:
const settle = await this.expireTurnHold(p);
        if (settle?.settle === "expired") await this.commitTurnDeadline(p);
mutations.expectRed: the goal's terminal is the deadline deny, reason `turn-deadline`
mutations.cell: the goal's terminal is the deadline deny, reason `turn-deadline`
mutations.note: The manager is the hold's owner and the only party that drives the deny; with the expiry gone the goal never terminalizes.

mutations.name: the sweep reads the settle but never produces it
mutations.find: return expireCheckpoint(gw.ctx.kv, gw.ctx.js, gw.ctx.jsm, this.space, { ref: { endpoint: p.ref.endpoint, token: p.holdToken }, now: Date.now() });
mutations.replace: return readCheckpointSettle(gw.ctx.jsm, this.space, { endpoint: p.ref.endpoint, token: p.holdToken });
mutations.expectRed: the goal's terminal is the deadline deny, reason `turn-deadline`
mutations.cell: the goal's terminal is the deadline deny, reason `turn-deadline`
mutations.note: A read-only sweep waits for a settle nobody writes: the manager holds no grant to consume the broker's fire, so the settle it reads for is one it has to produce.

mutations.name: an ended goal is re-admitted to the accept path
mutations.expectRed: a retry of the unwound accept is refused naming the terminal, never handed a live acceptance
mutations.cell: a retry of the unwound accept is refused naming the terminal, never handed a live acceptance
mutations.note: Without the terminal read the retry re-records the index over the unwind's tombstone and is refused as store corruption, or (before the rebuilt-acceptance branch was removed) handed a live deadline on a turn no seat is shown. The terminal is the one durable answer a retry of an ended goal deserves.

mutations.name: the unwind commits the failed terminal without the seat's currency
mutations.expectRed: the accept unwinds: refused to the caller, with a failed terminal committed on the bound goal
mutations.cell: the accept unwinds: refused to the caller, with a failed terminal committed on the bound goal
mutations.note: The goal is target-pinned, so core refuses a completion that proves no executor currency; the unwind then logged its own failure and left a bound goal with no ending, which is the state every later retry found.

mutations.name: the unwind leaves its index entry behind
mutations.expectRed: and no index entry remains for the ended goal, so no sweep finds a relay to adopt
mutations.cell: and no index entry remains for the ended goal, so no sweep finds a relay to adopt
mutations.note: The index entry was recorded before the bind; an unwind that does not take it back leaves a relay record pointing at an ended goal for every later boot sweep to read.
